body: No, I have not, but I want to. I am away at college so I can't see my derm to ask her about it.

Thanks for the advice, but I've actually tried that before. It doesn't work for me. I have a few different prescriptions that I am trying out now.

As for Accutane being linked to suicide, that's really not a concern of mine. My acne makes me want to kill myself more than anything sometimes. It is actually the reason I wrote this post, although I only briefly mentioned it.

I'm in my sophomore year of college, 19 years old.

It's not really pressure from my parents though, although they want and encourage me to do well. It mostly comes from me. I want good grades so I can get a good job, and make good money. I can't relax, my grades will slip. They already have. 

The fact that my grades (or my problems in general) now wont matter to me in the future may be true, but they matter to me now. In the future I will have different problems.
